remarks: PRICE IMPROVEMENT, BEST VALUE IN NEW CANAAN! Nestled on a quiet cul-de-sac, this fully renovated ranch offers a combination of comfort and style, sure to impress! Step inside and you will find a bright and airy floor-plan with beautiful hardwood throughout. Spacious living room with wood-burning fireplace that opens up to the eat-in kitchen and dining room, perfect for entertaining. Modern kitchen including custom cabinetry, stylish open shelving, high-end stainless steel appliances, and a large island with Calcutta Venice countertop. The primary bedroom features ample built-in closet space and a stunning en-suite bathroom with high-end design and finishes. Two additional bedrooms and luxury full bathroom with tub and double sink vanity complete the main level. The fully finished basement provides additional living space ideal for a family room or additional bedroom. It also includes its own full bathroom, laundry area, storage, and direct access to the two car garage. Step outside to the expansive, level lot that surrounds the home and get ready to enjoy the large deck and pavers patio all summer long. Additional features include central air, new windows, generator hookup, and freshly painted exterior and interior. Conveniently located near the Merritt and I-95, and just a short drive to downtown, where you'll have easy access to shopping, restaurants, parks, schools and the New Canaan train. With meticulous attention to detail throughout, this home shouldn't be missed!
